metadata.custom_param: Is Means of Egress (Yes/No on Rooms — add via Manage > Project Parameters; edit when_param if your project uses different name)

rules.description: Means of egress rooms must have ceiling height >= 2286 mm (IBC §1003.2). Stairs/ramps/doors handled by referenced exception sections.

extraction_meta.source_text: The means of egress shall have a ceiling height of not less than 7 feet 6 inches (2286 mm) above the finished floor.
notes: Headroom measured from finished floor to underside of obstruction (transom for doorway, beam/duct/pipe in general).
Term 'means of egress' includes exit access, exit, and exit discharge components.
